scope: Only the original 14 v3 boundary-contact development cases. Completed artifacts only; ongoing combined full evaluations excluded.
braking_definition: At least one negative actual RPM command in the future replay window.
quantiles: Pandas linear quantiles over overlapping replay origins; descriptive, not independent uncertainty intervals.
mode_counts: Last ten executed decisions including the collision-triggering decision; final phase read from maximum step per case.
